source_citation: Diggs, Lipscomb & O'Kennon (1999), Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas

morphology_source_reported.leaves: Ovate, sparse strigose leaflets 3–6.5 cm long, often 3-lobed or indented along margins
morphology_source_reported.flowers: Keel strongly incurved, darkened toward tip
morphology_source_reported.seeds: Thick felty covering, in contrast with shiny seeds of S. leiosperma

cautions: 1999 Flora uses Strophostyles helvula, documented as an orthographic variant of currently accepted S. helvola by ITIS and Kew; preserved as source_name.
Regional occurrence is not evidence of local BONAP nativity
